messages:
Alyssa (CS Lead): quick heads-up - we have a subset of tenants (~22) seeing intermittent indexing failures and higher embed latency since ~08:15 UTC. working with eng now. sending a short note to affected accounts in 20m.

Ravi (CS): thanks. can we confirm whether this is read/write impact or just background reindexing? i have 3 tenants flagged as high-touch.

Tom (Eng): it's primarily the embedding ingestion path - some write attempts are being retried and timing out, which causes partial index gaps. reads are mostly OK but embeddings for new docs are delayed. root cause looks like a transient gateway misrouting to an overloaded Dedicated pool. investigating.

Priya (Customer Manager): flagged two enterprise trials that are in onboarding - they asked about SLA exposure. want a suggested template for immediate outreach that emphasizes mitigation and timeline.

Alyssa (CS Lead): draft I'll send - short, empathetic, and clear. include: what happened, who is affected, mitigation in place, expected recovery window, temporary workarounds, and offer office hours. cc billing only if we decide credits.

Tom (Eng): mitigation update: we throttled routing to the overloaded pool and enabled fallback to the secondary pool for embedding writes. this reduces throughput but should stop timeouts. also pushed a short config change to increase write retries with jitter.

Alan (Infra): added a targeted autoscale bump to the secondary pool and cleaned a stuck worker causing GC spikes. metrics look better - error rate down 65% in the last 8m.

Priya (Customer Manager): great. can we provide tenant-level visibility? customers want to know if their specific docs will be reprocessed.

Tom (Eng): yes - we generated a per-tenant debug token and reenqueue list. we'll re-ingest docs with ids in the requeue file. I can share a secure link to the requeue CSV for CS-only access: https://redwood-internal/requeues/1745559999.csv (restricted).

Ravi (CS): sending initial outbound now to affected accounts. short note: "We're aware of delays with embedding ingestion for a subset of accounts since 08:15 UTC; engineering has put fallbacks in place and most tenants are recovering. We will reprocess missed items and follow up when complete. Office hours at 13:00 UTC for any impacted customers." includes link to support queue.

Alyssa (CS Lead): include expectation: reprocessing window ~2-4 hours from now for most tenants; we'll escalate any high-touch trials that need priority within the hour. add a contact line for the PM.

Priya (Customer Manager): notified the two onboarding trials and offered accelerated reprocess; they accepted office hours. logged renewal risk flag for the larger trial (contacted sales).

Tom (Eng): quick technical note for CS: when sharing status with customers, avoid saying 'database outage' - accurate phrasing: 'embedding ingestion delays due to routing to an overloaded inference pool; fallbacks and re-ingestion are underway.'

Alyssa (CS Lead): noted. Ravi please paste the outbound message copy here after you send. we'll collect responses and route to eng triage channel.

Ravi (CS): outbound sent at 09:03 UTC - copy pasted below:

"Hi - we're reaching out because we detected delayed embedding ingestion for a small number of accounts starting 08:15 UTC. Our engineers have implemented fallbacks and reprocessing; most customers should see normal behavior within 2-4 hours. If you rely on real-time ingestion, we can prioritize your tenant - please reply or join office hours at 13:00 UTC. Apologies for the interruption. - Redwood CS"

Alyssa (CS Lead): perfect. next steps: 1) eng to confirm full requeue completion and post an update in this thread, 2) CS to triage inbound replies and escalate trials, 3) if recovery extends past 4 hours, prepare a credit proposal and exec notification.

Alan (Infra): requeue is 40% complete; ETA ~90m based on current throughput. I'll post checkpoints at 30m intervals.

Priya (Customer Manager): capturing verbatim customer feedback in #cs-feedback. one customer asked for a per-document confirmation once reprocess completes - is that feasible?

Tom (Eng): we can provide a per-tenant reprocess manifest and a count of items re-ingested. per-document confirmations are heavy; propose: provide a manifest + sampling validation and escalate specific doc ids on request.

Alyssa (CS Lead): agreed. offer the manifest and a follow-up validation for any critical docs.

OpsBot: incident-status changed: degraded -> partial-recovery at 09:28 UTC. Incident ID: INC-1745559999. See internal dashboard: https://ops/redwood/incidents/INC-1745559999

Ravi (CS): nice. I'll update the customers to say partial recovery and share the manifest when available.

Alyssa (CS Lead): thanks team. keep this thread updated with requeue completion and any requests from customers that need urgent attention. we'll draft an RCA after the incident stabilizes. :thumbsup:
